sources.finding: Desktop-first AI development workflow orchestrator (Electron app plus agentico Go server/CLI): per-feature worktrees, KB, inquiry, research, design, roadmap and phase planning with plan critics, implementation, Final Review and publish via gh; Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode providers; Apache-2.0.

sources.title: Desktop release, updates and diagnostics
sources.locator: The resulting desktop assets are exactly
sources.finding: Desktop assets are exactly a macOS universal DMG, Linux x64/arm64 AppImages and amd64/arm64 .deb packages plus a signed desktop-release.json; staged in-app updates on DMG and AppImage; releases cut locally by the operator.

sources.title: Connecting the desktop app to a server on another machine
sources.locator: Running the server on the host; Pasting the connection string
sources.finding: agentico server --listen binds a network address with plain HTTP plus a bearer token and prints an agentico:// connection string; the desktop app attaches via Settings > Servers; trusted-network or SSH tunnel expected.

sources.title: Observability and fleet telemetry
sources.locator: intro; Outcome definitions; OTel resource identity
sources.finding: Local per-feature JSONL/summary artifacts (observability.events) separate from OpenTelemetry traces/metrics (otel_enabled, off unless enabled); defines output-ready, delivered and failure outcomes; installation ID stored locally; no repo names or paths in resource attributes.

sources.title: Agentico server API
sources.locator: Discovery And Auth; Parent/Child Relationships; Capability Gates; Supervisor Messages
sources.finding: Loopback REST/SSE API with owner-only discovery file and bearer token, snapshot-then-subscribe events, parent/child feature relationships, capability gates in testing contracts and supervisor messages; agentico api helper for authenticated calls.

sources.title: Supervisor background work
sources.finding: Background work panel lists provider-reported scheduled and event monitors and tasks (e.g. Claude CronCreate); ask-to-stop requires provider acknowledgement; interrupted tasks are not restarted.

sources.title: Feature state machine
sources.finding: Durable feature statuses incl. Created, Planning, Implementing, NeedUserInput, ReviewPassed, CodeReady, Published, Done, Failed, Interrupted with an explicit allowed-transition table.

sources.title: Child features
sources.finding: Child feature (refactor) relationships under a parent feature with lifecycle, discard and cascade delete.

sources.title: Work admission
sources.finding: Reservation-based work admission shared by HTTP entry points, orchestration and session launching, used to close admission during self-update installs.

sources.title: Configuration schema
sources.finding: YAML config with defaults.models, exit_criteria, max_iterations, max_consecutive_failures, max_consecutive_no_progress, inquireness, pipeline, repos, workspace_roots and observability settings.

sources.title: Apache-2.0 license

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
sources.finding: The cron/schedule/webhook hits are provider protocol fields, prompt fixtures and the update-check schedule; no user-facing scheduler or webhook trigger for features beyond supervisor monitoring of provider-reported tasks.

sources.title: Bounded search: issue trackers
sources.locator: rg -il "linear|jira|github issue|issue tracker" internal/ desktop/src docs/ README.md
sources.finding: No tracker integration or native issue entity; features are the work unit; gh is used only for PR creation.

sources.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO
sources.finding: No users, roles, SSO or organizations; one bearer token per server.

sources.title: Bounded search: sandbox and containers
sources.finding: Docker appears only as a testing-contract capability gate and release build tool; the Codex backend is started with a coarse sandbox mode (read-only/workspace write) and OpenCode gets a generated permission config; no per-feature container or VM isolation.

sources.title: Bounded search: billing
sources.finding: No pricing page or billing code; only codex-pricing.md (model price tables for cost estimates).

sources.title: Desktop quit coordinator
sources.finding: When active work exists, quitting offers Keep Running (hides the window and leaves work attached), Stop Work and Quit (sends stop requests before shutdown) or Cancel.

sources.title: Desktop main process shutdown
sources.locator: shutdown handler near line 1031-1056: app-owned runtime stopped via gateway.shutdown()
sources.finding: On quit the app stops a runtime it owns (app-owned) with gateway.shutdown(); a runtime the app does not own is released without being stopped.

sources.title: Session watchdog defaults
sources.finding: Sessions get idle-silence watchdogs: 5 minutes while a tool is pending, 30 minutes while a subagent task is pending and 5 minutes after tools finish before the turn completes; no overall wall-clock cap was found.
